newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares close mixed in high volumes.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares close mixed in high volumes.

text.p: Leading Russian shares closed mixed on Thursday in high volumes on Western demand for underpriced stocks, traders said.
The Russian Trading System index of 24 shares rose by 0.50 percent to 185.27 on $15.20 million in volume.

"Most trade is done by those who are not ready to leave the market right now and they buy underpriced shares," a trader who asked not to be named, said. "We can see some demand today as the market has been sinking for some time and prices of many shares, including Norilsk Nickel and UES became attractive."
UES rose to $0.0834 from $0.0829 at Wednesday's close and Norilsk Nickel rose to $5.18 from $5.10.
Samit Yakovlev, chief trader from United City Bank, said there was aggressive demand for UES.

"Buying in UES was quite aggressive today, which is strange as regardless of the results of the auction there will be a fall in the share price," he said. "Speculation with the share is very risky today."
Bids for 8.5 percent of UES shares being auctioned will be accepted until December 23. The price of a share is 500 roubles (about $0.09).
Another underpriced share was Irkutskenergo, which rose to $0.122 from $0.121, the trader said.
Traders forecast a quiet market until mid-January.
Tsum's plans to issue level one American Depositary Receipts next year, announced today, had no impact on the market. The share was not traded on Thursday.

Chelyabenergo rose to $0.195 from $0.160 on December 15 when it was last traded, Mosenergo was $0.968 after $0.964, LUKoil edged down to $10.00 from $10.33 and Elektrosvayz fell to $1.216 from $1.35 on November 20 close when it was last traded.
